speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are presenting with hematuria and right flank pain. To begin my assessment, have you experienced any fever, nausea, or visible clots in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Renal Cell Carcinoma. Given the patient's age, visible hematuria, and right flank pain without fever or trauma, malignancy is the primary concern. I am requesting a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis with contrast to evaluate the renal parenchyma. REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis_With_Contrast. REQUEST IMAGES.
